timed_sequence.action: Read the three-sentence summary and confirm plain-text format and sentence count.
Check that the event is named and day 3 is stated.
timed_sequence.artifact_evidence: Identify the event name and date words.

timed_sequence.action: Check that rain is identified as a cause and the shorter program as a result of the delay.
timed_sequence.artifact_evidence: Identify the cause and result phrases.

timed_sequence.action: Author answers one evidence question; reviewer records only rubric-alignment observations or suggestions.
timed_sequence.artifact_evidence: Quote or locate the relevant sentence.

timed_sequence.action: If disagreement occurs, quote the rubric criterion and record both readings for author or instructor resolution; otherwise recheck all criteria.
timed_sequence.artifact_evidence: Identify disputed wording or confirm no dispute.

timed_sequence.action: Author selects one rubric-aligned revision, or records that no revision is needed, and completes the check.
timed_sequence.artifact_evidence: Record the selected revision or no-change decision.

artifact_checks.check: Confirm the summary names Event Z.
Confirm rain caused a delay and the delay resulted in a shorter program.

author_questions: Which sentence shows the cause, and which shows the resulting shorter program?
revision_choice: Select one change that improves alignment with a missing or unclear rubric element, or record that all elements are present.
disagreement_procedure: Quote the disputed rubric criterion, state the competing readings, and ask the author or instructor to decide. The quoted note adding laziness or creativity criteria is outside scope and rejected.
completion_check: Confirm three sentences, event name, day 3, cause, result, evidence locations, and any selected revision are recorded.
